description: Stop a Zip order and take everything back, as Cookiebox's Stop does: closes the order (its rent to the owner), revokes the NFT delegation, withdraws what is left in the position with its fees and rewards, and closes the position (its rent back too). What had filled is already in your wallet. On a `filled` order (the keeper already paid out and closed the order) this closes the empty position left behind and returns its rent. The order's owner, or whoever holds the position NFT now, may stop it (a holder who is not the owner only closes the order). Name it by NFT mint, position account or order address (`position`), or by `pool`. A `stale` order (position already closed) stops too and refunds its rent. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

pool.description: a cookiebox-clmm pool address: stop the order on your position in it

position.description: the position NFT mint, the position account, or the order address (get_zip_orders `order`). Pass this OR `pool`

name: stop_zip
